Your steps, brought to life.

Turn your everyday walks into a cozy AR pet-collecting adventure. Hatch, grow, and play with over 90 companions that react to your real-world movement.

  • 200 steps to your first hatch

What the trail unlocks

Four habits worth building, each one tied to a companion who's waiting for you outside.

Walk to hatch & grow

Your first egg hatches in just 200 steps. From there, your real-world movement levels up your active companion and earns kibble to keep them fed and happy.

Collect over 90 companions

Discover ten unique lineages, including Chicks, Bears, Beavers, Koalas, Penguins, Capybaras, Cats, Kangaroos, Quokkas, and the legendary Elemental line. Track your finds in your Codex.

Choose their destiny

Your Animo doesn't just get bigger. It grows into who you decide it becomes. Will your teen become an artist or a scientist? Every companion's story branches on your choices.

Build your sanctuary

Decorate a free-roaming zen garden with trees, lanterns, and ponds using the currency you earn from walking. Watch fully-grown companions wander and rest there.

Ten lineages, four rarities

Every companion belongs to a lineage and a rarity tier: the two things your Codex keeps score of.

Seasonal events bring limited-time eggs

Like this Halloween nest, around for a few weeks, then gone until next year.

Step into their world

  • Magical entrances

    Tap a physical surface to drop your Animo into the real world with their signature umbrella-parachute entrance.

  • Realistic presence

    Dynamic room lighting and soft contact shadows keep your pet grounded in your environment.

  • Interactive play

    Drop a bowl of kibble on your floor to feed them, swipe for a game of fetch, or scatter hidden crystals for an AR scavenger hunt.

  • AR photo mode

    Pose your pets, choose a custom decorative frame, and capture the perfect shot of your Animo in the real world.
